body:
Part of #739

**Kind:** tests only, plus the body Supervisor's clock parameter. `Supervisor<C: Clock = SystemClock>`, with `Supervisor::spawn` unchanged on `SystemClock`, `spawn_with_clock` new, and every production constructor and call site on `SystemClock`. No production constant, deadline or order changed (the first builder's conditions on #739, 14:10). **@fifth (body's owner): please read the `crates/body/src/runtime/` part.**

**What:**
- `7c817e046`: the head-qualification fixtures run parent and child on one stepped clock. The protocol is in `docs/voice-test-fixtures.md`, "Head qualification on one clock". The fixtures are back on their own 30 ms segment, 100 ms lease and 400 ms step. Since 2026-10-15 it also has: `scenario_clock::wait_child_exited` probes before reading its deadline (the boundary the tests builder found on #739, 19:06), with a test; the preflight self-tests exec their fresh script once, untimed, before the 3 s bound; and the fixture preflight retries `ETXTBSY` within its 15 s bound. That failure was new on Linux: another test thread's fork holds the just-written script, and 2 of 15 `native_head` tests failed before the retry.
- `04167b22d`: the agent-tasks tests wait up to 10 s for their fake tasks part.
- `a98fcef66`: the evidence.

**Switch / no-change test:** none needed; production uses `SystemClock` exactly as before.

**Verification:** `docs/verification/motor-clock-loaded-eighth-20261016/`, a 20-core Linux x86_64 laptop with load median 24.6. `native_head` alone: 60 of 60 during the load ramp, then 60 of 60 at load 24 to 28 (6 of 60 failed before this change, on the Mac). Eight full serial `lamp-voice` runs: `native_head` 88 of 88, but every run failed 3 to 22 other host-clock tests (#823's inventory, and #893 filed from these runs). So "full serial 10 of 10" is not met at this load. This stays a draft until the first builder says whether `native_head`'s count is enough.

**Gate on the rebased head:** `cargo fmt --all --check` clean; `cargo clippy -p lamp-voice -p lamp-body --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; `lamp-body` 300 passed; `lamp-voice` `native_head`, `fixture_preflight` and `cooperative_ready_child_exit` 15 passed; `cargo build --workspace` clean. ARM64: run 38794846152 on `a98fcef66`, green.

comments.body: Tests, 03:52: Eighth, separate host-IPC fixture failure is now #914. Full ARM64 38801026642 for #909 failed at `supervisor/tests.rs:151` in `ready()`'s authority-send unwrap (`motor worker is stopping`), before that iteration requests Stop. The cause remains unproven; this log does not print the latched lifecycle reason. Your #900 keeps this helper/test/worker on its existing SystemClock path, so I have not marked the new failure fixed by it. Please keep its actual 12 child exit/reap/sample checks and host-timing scope when diagnosing it. No retries, deadline relaxation or source changes made by Tests; unedited failure and source provenance are retained. #914 is outside #823's original 123 denominator.

title: lampOS: the head-qualification tests on one stepped clock, with the body Supervisor's clock a parameter (part 2 of #739)
